|translation='''Title:''' Frozen dinner.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any character alone at the Wampa Cave. The character is power = 0 and may not move. Canceled if an opponent's lightsaber or total ability > 4 is at that location. If the character is eaten by a creature, add 2 to ferocity (cumulative).

'''Lore:'''
Freeze-dried and ready to eat, outstanding flavor! Feed the whole wampa clan on Rebel scum. Humans are gr-r-reat.
